description: Ministry of Defence - The Vishista Seva Vibhushanaya 2019, 2020, 2021 Padakkam
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists named military personnel (Major Generals, Rear Admirals, Air Vice Marshals) who are being conferred a national honor (Vishista Seva Vibhushanaya). It contains the names and basic titles/ranks of the individuals but provides no details about their specific duties, responsibilities, or portfolio assignments. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2), which covers appointments, awards, and other personnel changes without detailed portfolio descriptions.
